sql.query: UPDATE tbl_contract_templates ct SET ct.templateName=:templateName,ct.description=NULLIF(:description,''),ct.templateKey=NULLIF(TRIM(:templateKey),''),ct.subjectTemplate=NULLIF(TRIM(:subjectTemplate),''),ct.bodyHtml=:bodyHtml,ct.textTemplate=NULLIF(:textTemplate,''),ct.isActive=:isActive,ct.versionNumber=ct.versionNumber+1,ct.modifiedByUserId=:userId,ct.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ct.id=:id AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND ct.outputType=:outputType AND NULLIF(TRIM(:templateName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:bodyHtml2),'') IS NOT NULL AND (:outputType2<>'email' OR NULLIF(TRIM(:subjectTemplate2),'') IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 AND ((ct.outputType='email' AND p.permissionCode='email.configure') OR (ct.outputType<>'email' AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure')))
